What degraded

  • The deck shipped at the round cap at 6.76, 1.24 under the 8.0 top rung. The art median is 6.0 and the craft floor stood down at the cap.
  • Two post-cap integrity corrections re-rendered frames 4 (kicker) and 6 (11.2 to 11.16 million) after round 3 was scored, so the score row in the run record reads stale.
  • Frame 3's map has no county lines, because Canyon is not in the committed gazetteer and census.gov refused both routes to its point.
  • The reader judges asked for a route a reader could take the closing question to, and the run fetched none.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The pens are counted. The AI isn't., paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

USDA is paying for half of a research feedlot near Canyon.

The A&M System calls the $9.75 million grant to West Texas A&M the largest federal award in WT's history. A dollar-for-dollar match from the System, the Texas Cattle Feeders Association, donors and other sources brings the project to $19.5 million.

The feedlot will pair 90 small research pens with 45 commercial-scale pens. Ground was broken in November 2025 next to WT's Nance Ranch.

On September 1st USDA estimated 2.5 million cattle on feed in Texas's large feedlots. Nebraska and Kansas each had fewer.

The release mentions AI once. New techniques "can be evaluated" with traditional and AI-powered approaches. It names no AI tool, vendor, camera, model or result.

If AI is tested in these pens, will WT's Feedlot Research Group name the tool and report the result?

#WestTexasAM #CanyonTX #TexasPanhandle

The machine changed itself

  • knowledge/carousel/MACHINE_QUEUE.md, four new items and three repeats raised
    feedyard models built in the chassis, the kit steer's head can't lower for a close crop, a low sun along a row of cattle shades each steer, and Canyon is missing from the committed gazetteer; the GRID piece count, the kit person mannequin and the accent drift under a lamp each met again
  • two instincts added, two confirmed
    run a row across a low key, and keep a kit animal whole under the type band; acceptance lists can't catch their own frame and a frame median is the reserve and the sky, both held

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

The record. 129 items were due. reverify.py asked 218 urls behind 833 claims, and 104 checked notes were re-worded and 17 items hand-stamped one source at a time. tx-2026-0203, Taylor's data center annexation, is decided: the city council approved it on October 8th under written water, setback and noise terms. tx-2026-0168, Hays County, records the court's September 15th 3 to 2 vote. tx-2026-0213, UT San Antonio's OpenSecCoder training platform, was admitted. A helper fault, disclosed. The first hand-check helper measured capitol.texas.gov pages as refused because it passed the boundary one item. Those results were discarded and nothing was stamped on them. The deck. tx-2026-0207, West Texas A&M's $9.75 million USDA grant for a research feedlot near Canyon. The release says new techniques can be evaluated with AI-powered approaches and names no AI tool, vendor or result. No county is named because the release names none. The map on frame 3 is a plan at one scale with no county lines, because Canyon is not in the committed gazetteer and census.gov refused both routes to its point. AgriLife's 2019 drone feedlot near Amarillo is a different feedlot and stays out of the deck, though two judges asked for it.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
